hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sc=./tools/spec-spine/spec-compiler/target/release/spec-compiler; ci=./tools/spec-spine/codebase-indexer/target/release/codebase-indexer; if [ -x "$sc" ]; then "$sc" compile >/dev/null 2>&1 && reg='recompiled fresh' || reg='compile FAILED — run make spec-compile'; else reg='compiler unbuilt — run make setup'; fi; if [ -x "$ci" ]; then "$ci" check >/dev/null 2>&1 && idx='fresh' || idx='STALE — run make index'; else idx='indexer unbuilt — run make setup'; fi; echo "[session-freshness] spec registry: $reg; codebase index: $idx"; true

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in "gh pr create"*|*"&& gh pr create"*|*"; gh pr create"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; out=$(make pr-prep 2>&1); ec=$?; if [ $ec -ne 0 ]; then case "$cmd" in *--body*Spec-Drift-Waiver*) echo '[pr-gate] coupling gate failed; Spec-Drift-Waiver present after --body — allowing (CI honours the body-at-creation waiver).' ;; *) { echo '[pr-gate] BLOCKED — make pr-prep failed and no Spec-Drift-Waiver in the PR body:'; echo "$out" | tail -25; echo '[pr-gate] Either fix the coupling (edit the owning spec.md so the relationship graph covers the changed paths), or — with explicit user approval — include the Spec-Drift-Waiver block inline in --body (not --body-file; it must be present at creation) and retry.'; } >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; fi; if ! git diff --quiet -- .derived/codebase-index/ 2>/dev/null; then { echo '[pr-gate] BLOCKED — pr-prep regenerated .derived/codebase-index/ and the result is uncommitted.'; echo '[pr-gate] Run: git add .derived/codebase-index/ then amend or commit, push, and retry.'; } >&2; exit 2; fi; true

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *UPDATE_GOLDEN*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sc=./tools/spec-spine/spec-compiler/target/release/spec-compiler; if [ -x "$sc" ]; then if "$sc" compile >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[golden-prep] spec registry recompiled before golden update — a stale registry yields silently-wrong goldens that pass locally but fail CI'; else echo '[golden-prep] spec registry compile FAILED — goldens would be generated from a stale registry; run make spec-compile'; fi; fi ;; esac; true

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[hook] jq missing — staleness check skipped'; exit 0; }; fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; case "$fp" in */specs/*/spec.md) sc=./tools/spec-spine/spec-compiler/target/release/spec-compiler; if [ -x "$sc" ]; then if "$sc" compile >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[spec-registry] recompiled after spec edit'; else echo '[spec-registry] compile FAILED after spec edit — run make spec-compile to see the error'; fi; fi ;; esac; case "$fp" in */Cargo.toml|*/package.json|*/pnpm-workspace.yaml|*/specs/*/spec.md|*/.claude/settings.json|*/.mcp.json|*/.claude/agents/*.md|*/.claude/commands/*.md|*/.claude/rules/*.md|*/.claude/skills/*/*.md|*/.claude/skills/*/*/*.md|*/.github/workflows/*.yml|*/.github/workflows/*.yaml|*/standards/schemas/*) [ -x ./tools/spec-spine/codebase-indexer/target/release/codebase-indexer ] && ./tools/spec-spine/codebase-indexer/target/release/codebase-indexer check 2>&1 | tail -5 ;; esac; true

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; ci=./tools/spec-spine/codebase-indexer/target/release/codebase-indexer; [ -x "$ci" ] || exit 0; "$ci" check >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; if [ -d .git/rebase-merge ] || [ -d .git/rebase-apply ] || [ -f .git/MERGE_HEAD ] || [ -f .git/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD ]; then echo '[codebase-index] stale, but rebase/merge in progress — left untouched (the oap-index-regen merge driver owns conflicts); run make index afterwards'; exit 0; fi; out=$(make index 2>&1); if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo '[codebase-index] was stale — auto-regenerated via make index; review git diff .derived/codebase-index/ and include it in your commit (amend if you just committed)'; else echo '[codebase-index] stale and make index FAILED:'; echo "$out" | tail -10; fi; true
